title: Homology of an additive open stalk chain square
statement: Let j:Y→Z be an open immersion, y a point of Y, and i an integer, with the derived categories of module sheaves existing. Let N,N0 be sheaf complexes on Z,Y, V,V0 complexes of modules over the corresponding stalk rings, e an isomorphism of these rings, t:V→restrictScalars(e)(V0), a:V→stalk(N), b:V0→stalk(N0), and alpha:restrict(j)(N)→N0. Assume degreewise that a, followed by inverse additive restrictStalkNatIso and stalk(alpha), equals t followed by b after forgetting scalars. Then homology(t), exact restriction-of-scalars homology, homology(b), and inverse comparisonStalkHomologyIso on Y compose to homology(a), inverse comparisonStalkHomologyIso on Z, openDerivedStalkIso(j), and additive derived stalk cohomology of openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(j,N) inverse followed by Q(alpha). The comparisons are the constructed ones of [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso]. No tensor formula or input coordinate is asserted.

proof.text: Take the short complex in degree i of each complex. The degreewise hypothesis at the predecessor, i and successor gives equality of additive short-complex maps by extensionality. Apply ShortComplex.homologyMap and its composition law. Naturality of mapHomologyIso moves the forgetful comparisons across a,t,b and stalk(alpha). The private proved homology_comparison_comp computes the restriction-of-scalars/forgetting comparison from common mapped left homology data.

Apply the representative identity [lem-pc-open-derived-stalk-representative-homology] to N. Naturality of comparisonStalkHomologyIso for alpha moves the restricted inverse representative comparison past Q(alpha). Cancel the ambient invertible forgetful comparison and use the equality of additive homology maps from the preceding step. Postcompose with the endpoint forgetful and representative comparisons to get precisely the original equation.

theorem openStalk_chain_homology_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (y : Y) (i : ℤ)
    (N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (N0 : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Z.presheaf.stalk (j y))) ℤ)
    (V0 : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) ℤ)
    (e : Z.presheaf.stalk (j y) ≃+* Y.presheaf.stalk y)
    (t : V ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} e.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj V0)
    (a : V ⟶ ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (j y)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj N)
    (b : V0 ⟶ ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj N0)
    (alpha : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N ⟶ N0)
    (h : ∀ k : ℤ,
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Z.presheaf.stalk (j y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (a.f k) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso j y).inv.app (N.X k) ≫
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).map (alpha.f k)) =
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Z.presheaf.stalk (j y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (t.f k) ≫
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map (b.f k)) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Z.presheaf.stalk (j y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology Y y i ⋙ F0
    F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t i) ≫
        F.map ((V0.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} e.toRingHom)).hom ≫
        F0.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap b i ≫
          (comparisonStalkHomologyIso Y y N0 i).inv) =
      F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap a i ≫
        (comparisonStalkHomologyIso Z (j y) N i).inv) ≫
        (openDerivedStalkIso j y i).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
        HU.map ((openRestrictionRepresentativeIso j N).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map alpha)
